name: Cleartext HTTP Communication
description: Unencrypted HTTP URL connection detected in source code or resources.
reason: Cleartext HTTP traffic can be intercepted, inspected, or tampered with via Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) network attacks.
recommendation: Enforce HTTPS with TLS 1.3/1.2 for all remote endpoints and configure Network Security Configuration to disallow cleartext traffic.

name: Trust All Certificates / SSL Bypass
description: Custom X509TrustManager or HostnameVerifier ignoring certificate validation detected.
reason: Bypassing certificate checks allows any MitM proxy to intercept encrypted SSL/TLS traffic.
recommendation: Use default system certificate trust stores or implement strict SSL Pinning.
